from supabase import create_client

url = ''https://xhvsvhiysnacdinclncn.supabase.co''
key = ''eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InhodnN2aGl5c25hY2RpbmNsbmNuIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3NTc5MTc1MjgsImV4cCI6MjA3MzQ5MzUyOH0.c2jd6mZfQP2X4XSjxmdeqteZ16JRV3-6W-Uyq7oYqng''

client = create_client\(url, key\)

print\(''=== ciq.fact_cola_applications Summary ===''\)

# Get total count
result = client.schema\(''ciq''\).table\(''fact_cola_applications''\).select\(''ttb_id'', count=''exact''\).limit\(1\).execute\(\)
print\(f''Total records: {result.count}''\)

# Get distinct partition dates
result = client.schema\(''ciq''\).table\(''fact_cola_applications''\).select\(''partition_date''\).limit\(1000\).execute\(\)
dates = sorted\(set\(r[''partition_date''] for r in result.data if r[''partition_date'']\)\)
print\(f''\\nPartition dates found: {len\(dates\)}''\)
print\(f''Date range: {dates[0]} to {dates[-1]}'' if dates else ''No dates''\)
print\(f''Sample dates: {dates[:5]}...''\)

# Get sample TTB IDs to understand structure
print\(''\\n=== Sample TTB IDs ===''\)
result = client.schema\(''ciq''\).table\(''fact_cola_applications''\).select\(''ttb_id, partition_date''\).order\(''ttb_id'', desc=True\).limit\(10\).execute\(\)
for row in result.data:
    ttb_id = row[''ttb_id'']
    # Parse TTB ID: YYJJJRRRSSSSS \(14 digits\)
    if len\(ttb_id\) == 14:
        year = ttb_id[0:2]
        julian = ttb_id[2:5]
        receipt = ttb_id[5:8]
        seq = ttb_id[8:14]
        print\(f''  {ttb_id} -> year={year}, julian={julian}, receipt_method={receipt}, sequence={seq}, partition={row[""partition_date""]}''\)
    else:
        print\(f''  {ttb_id} \(unexpected length: {len\(ttb_id\)}\)''\)
")

Bash(python3 -c "
from supabase import create_client

url = ''https://xhvsvhiysnacdinclncn.supabase.co''
key = ''eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InhodnN2aGl5c25hY2RpbmNsbmNuIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3NTc5MTc1MjgsImV4cCI6MjA3MzQ5MzUyOH0.c2jd6mZfQP2X4XSjxmdeqteZ16JRV3-6W-Uyq7oYqng''

client = create_client\(url, key\)

print\(''=== Max TTB ID per Partition Date \(sample\) ===''\)

# Get all records and group by partition_date to find max ttb_id
# Since we can''t do GROUP BY directly, we''ll query a few specific dates
sample_dates = [''2020-01-03'', ''2020-01-15'', ''2025-07-20'']

for date in sample_dates:
    result = client.schema\(''ciq''\).table\(''fact_cola_applications''\).select\(''ttb_id''\).eq\(''partition_date'', date\).order\(''ttb_id'', desc=True\).limit\(1\).execute\(\)
    if result.data:
        max_ttb = result.data[0][''ttb_id'']
        # Parse sequence from TTB ID
        seq = int\(max_ttb[8:14]\) if len\(max_ttb\) == 14 else ''unknown''
        receipt = max_ttb[5:8] if len\(max_ttb\) == 14 else ''unknown''
        print\(f''{date}: max_ttb_id={max_ttb}, receipt_method={receipt}, max_sequence={seq}''\)
    else:
        print\(f''{date}: No data''\)

# Count records per partition_date for a few dates
print\(''\\n=== Record counts per partition date ===''\)
for date in sample_dates:
    result = client.schema\(''ciq''\).table\(''fact_cola_applications''\).select\(''ttb_id'', count=''exact''\).eq\(''partition_date'', date\).limit\(1\).execute\(\)
    print\(f''{date}: {result.count} records''\)
")
